content: नाल {%a.%} [नलस्येदम् अण्] Consisting or made of reeds; नालं वनं थूथपतिर्यथोन्मदः. .{@-लम्@} .²1 A hollow stalk, especially the stalk of the lotus; विकचकमलैः दीर्घवैडूर्यनालैः <ls>Me. 78</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 13</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 89</ls>. --({%m.%} also in this sense). .²2 Any tubular vessel of the body. .²3 Yellow orpiment. .²4 A handle. .²5 The neck; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .{@-लः@} A canal, drain. .({@-लम्, -लः@}) The navel-string.
